Row.Text: Transitional unit used while the Giga Fortress transforms. Lives for 3.5 seconds and cannot be selected or ordered.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If you can read this, the transformation was interrupted (save/load or error) and it will auto-convert.
The Giga Fortress needs several seconds of mechanical reconfiguration to switch between its naval and airborne forms.
